name: doc-summarize-with-fetch
description: Fetch a document from an allowlisted host, summarize it with a cost-capped Model call, and return the summary. Demonstrates the Http node (host must be a static literal in allowed_hosts) + max_cost_usd per call + the Output collection. Run detail exposes the fetch and summary records; an eligible terminal receipt can be minted on demand as a signed aggregate estimate.

nodes.prompt: Summarize the fetched document in 5 bullet points. Document: {{nodes.fetch.body}}
